svg.text: Example: Candida albicans SC5314, public WGS run SRR4428735 (even coverage, ~140x)
Full reference length; MAPQ 20, base quality 20. Each screen column shows base-depth median (blue) and 10th–90th percentile (pale).
Vertical scales are independent by chromosome; the number under each name is that chromosome's typical depth. Red marks: screen columns with >50% uncovered bases.
